title: Facebook Fake ID, Blackmail & Cyber Harassment Complaint Bangladesh 2026: Police GD & Legal Action
metaTitle: Facebook Harassment & Fake ID Complaint Bangladesh 2026 | Police GD
metaDescription: How to file a police complaint against fake Facebook profiles, photo morphing, and online blackmail in Bangladesh under the Cyber Security Act 2023.
heroIntro: Impersonation, photo tampering, and malicious defamation on social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok constitute severe criminal offences under the Cyber Security Act 2023 and Penal Code 1860. Authored by Advocate Md. Shah Alam, Supreme Court Advocate. Call our Uttara chamber at 01712655546.

quickAnswer.heading: ⚡ Golden Rules for Cyber Evidence Preservation
points: Do NOT Delete Chats: Preserve raw chat transcripts, voice notes, and threat timestamps without editing.
Extract Numeric Profile ID: Copy the permanent profile link or numeric account ID rather than just user vanity names.
File Police GD within 24 Hours: Lodge an official General Diary at your local police station.

sections.heading: 1. Offence Categories under Cyber Security Act 2023
sections.content: Covers identity fraud, defamation, non-consensual sharing of intimate media, and digital extortion.

sections.heading: 2. Essential Digital Evidence Required
sections.content: High-resolution screenshots, profile URLs, screen recordings, and server timestamps are admissible under Section 65B of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: 3. How to Draft a Strong Police GD
sections.content: Recite exact facts chronologically and request forwarding to CID Cyber Crime Lab for technical tracing of IP addresses and device IMEI numbers.

sections.heading: 4. Content Takedown & Subpoena to Meta
sections.content: Law enforcement issues formal Mutual Legal Assistance / government requests to Meta for expeditious account termination.

sections.heading: 5. Criminal Prosecution & Legal Representation
sections.content: For cyber defamation and extortion litigation, contact Supreme Court Advocate Md. Shah Alam at 01712655546.

faq.question: What is the punishment for fake ID blackmail in Bangladesh?
faq.answer: Imprisonment up to 5 years and substantial fines under the Cyber Security Act.
